5e39e937e188e1ed35f2bbb4d9cf9dea6f07f854.scene_en: A lone ultramarathon runner on a circular forest trail at dawn, several translucent overlapping silhouettes suggesting many repeated laps and endurance through the night. Curving dynamic brushstrokes, no phone, no city buildings.

10e33e4addbb6b77627fea9c93c1b2bdb49d0033.scene_en: A quiet Moscow apartment sanctuary: sculptural pale stone and warm wooden surfaces, a soft sofa, a large window framing distant city rooftops. Geometric architectural planes, calm generous light and contemplative empty space.

095b6c31c553e38134a5277f1b06ee026e69be73.scene_en: An American elm tree with a broad vase-shaped crown, new green seedlings emerging beneath it. Delicate branching roots connect genetically diverse young trees, a visual metaphor for restoring disease-resistant elm populations. No city streets or buildings.

58464c0b913c8eb7e26f4a7c9a122e169065d2bf.scene_en: In a Central African village, a community spiritual elder and a healthcare worker meet with families under a large tree, an open circle and a bridge of warm light symbolizing trust during Ebola response. Abstract human figures, no portrait likeness, no hospital signs, no snow or European buildings.

69e87f49e218b714a71851b9aa8442ba557481c3.scene_en: A close-up still life of winter running shoes with deeply textured gripping soles, snow crystals and rain droplets, a winding icy trail receding into the background. Flowing decorative curves and botanical patterns. No brand marks or written labels.

622864a94513688d9a15f84f52eca43aed8ecc4a.scene_en: A bundle of blank envelopes and small colorful childlike drawings glowing warmly in the hands of an elderly man, with a distant classroom and a connecting ribbon of light. Metaphor for letters from schoolchildren sustaining a soldier and kindness remembered across generations. No writing on paper.

076df96c6dcc1a9d23622e45fd9eca5ec1259b7a.scene_en: A person sitting awake beside a bed holding a softly glowing phone, a dark window and a small bedside lamp, the blanket extending like a quiet river toward sleep. Metaphor for bedtime procrastination, boredom and the temptation to keep scrolling. No visible screen text, no forest.

32c35848803d0dc46fb768fdc14d2a1f3fa04d10.scene_en: Children absorbed in free imaginative play on a safe sunlit playroom floor, assembling wooden blocks, a cardboard arch and fabric tents while an adult quietly watches from the doorway. Loose warm brushstrokes, a visual metaphor for autonomy and creativity, no written letters.
